universe: 59 pre-screened liquid U.S. listings; $2–$120 price; 20-day average volume of at least 500,000 shares
methodology: Availability-adjusted skill screen: price momentum 30%, sector support 20%, technical trend 15%, volume/positioning 10%, expectation room 10%, downside risk 10%, liquidity 5%.
limitations: This automated first pass uses delayed or previous-close price and volume data. It does not include live analyst revisions, fundamental valuation, options positioning, or a verified event calendar; those require a full cited research pass.
